evidence: The settings manifest registers the three page descriptors. Each creator stores allocated page state, and each destroyer frees and clears it. UI builders register event callbacks for display modes and time rows. The handlers inspect the event data and call the relevant display or wrist setting functions.
scope: The listed lifecycle slots and UI call sites; other settings and direct writes to display state are not covered.
limitations: The callbacks can change device display power and wrist activation behavior. Modifying user data or skipping registrations can desynchronize options and stored state. Page state and root slots do not stop other threads; device behavior and recovery are unverified.
